extracted.intended_audience: MD/PhD students or applicants considering the Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans
extracted.subtask_description: Eligibility guidance for when MD/PhD applicants (or students at various stages of MD and PhD phases) may apply to the Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans, including rules for applying while in the application process and how funding maps to program years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat MD and PhD as separate degrees
rubrics_metrics.description: At the Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans, we treat the MD and PhD as separate degrees. As a result, eligibility is based on your current stage in each program—not your overall standing in the combined MD/PhD program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret your eligibility relative to the specific degree phase you are in (MD-phase or PhD-phase). Do not use your combined program year to determine eligibility; instead consider whether you are within the eligible window for the particular degree you seek funding for.

rubrics_metrics.name: General eligibility window: applying or within first two years of each degree
rubrics_metrics.description: You are eligible to apply when applying to the MD/PhD program or within the first two years of each degree program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This rule applies separately to each degree (MD and PhD). If you are applying to the combined MD/PhD program, that counts as eligibility for the MD portion. If you are in the first two years of the PhD portion, that counts as eligibility for the PhD portion.

rubrics_metrics.name: MD portion eligibility (when funding can apply to MD years)
rubrics_metrics.description: MD Portion: When you’re applying to the MD/PhD program or during your first and second years of medical school, you’re eligible to apply just like any other MD student at that level. In the final year of your PhD, you could apply for the Fellowship to cover your 3rd and 4th years of medical school.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you apply during MD years 1–2, eligibility is the same as other MD applicants. If you apply in the final year of your PhD, you may request funding that will be applied to the later clinical years of medical school (3rd & 4th years). Use timeline examples to confirm which academic years the Fellowship would fund based on your application timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: PhD portion eligibility (when funding can apply to PhD years)
rubrics_metrics.description: PhD Portion: Once you transition into your PhD training, you’re again eligible to apply during your first two years of the PhD program. In the second year of your MD or in the first 2 years of your PhD training, you are again eligible to apply for funding directed towards your PhD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may apply for funding that specifically supports the PhD portion if you are in MD year 2 or PhD years 1–2. Confirm that the funding period aligns with the PhD years you intend to support. The key test is whether you are within the first two years of the PhD phase (or in MD year 2, which can be the window for PhD-directed funding).

rubrics_metrics.name: Must not have started the third year of the specific degree by application deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: You are eligible as long as you have not started the third year of the specific degree you are seeking funding for by our application deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate eligibility separately for the degree you want funded: even if you have advanced in the other degree, you remain eligible if, for that specific degree, you have not yet begun year three at the application deadline. This is the strict cutoff for each degree's eligibility window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying while in the application process (must enroll full-time by cohort start)
rubrics_metrics.description: Even if you’re in the process of applying to your MD/PhD program, you can still apply for our Fellowship. However, you must be enrolled full-time in the MD/PhD program by the time the Fellowship cohort you applied for begins in order to maintain eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you apply before matriculating to an MD/PhD program, ensure you will be accepted and begin the program by the Fellowship start date (cohort start). Example given: if applying for the 2026 Fellowship while applying to MD/PhD programs, you must be accepted and begin by Fall 2026 (when 2026 Fellowship funding begins). If you cannot guarantee enrollment by cohort start, you will not meet eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline examples for mapping application timing to funded years
rubrics_metrics.description: Example timeline provided: Fall 2025–Fall 2026 (first two years of MD phase) — Eligible; If you apply in Fall 2026, the Fellowship would apply to your first year of the PhD program. Fall 2027–Fall 2028 (first two years of PhD phase) — Eligible. Fall 2029: Third year of your PhD phase but because you are not yet in your third year of your MD program, ... you would be eligible to apply. Fall 2030: At this point you have started the third year of both the MD and the PhD so you would not be eligible to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the concrete example to determine how an application year maps to the Fellowship-funded years. The examples illustrate that eligibility and funded-year mapping depend on which degree-year you will be in when funding begins, and that starting year three in a degree by the cohort start disqualifies you for that degree's funding.
